subject: Invoice reconciliation & credit offset for contract close — actions and VAT verification
messages:
From: accounts-payable@everleaf.io
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Knox <julie.knox@everleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice query — Redwood contract close (Q2 commitments)

Hi Priyom,

We received the invoice labeled "Redwood Inference — End of Term Invoice" this morning but our AP team has a couple of questions before we process payment:

- The invoice shows the committed capacity credit but the math doesn't match our usage records (we believe there should be an additional €7,200 credit for unused burst).
- VAT treatment: our accounting needs confirmation whether Redwood will apply reverse-charge (EU B2B) on the final invoice or whether VAT is charged. We need Redwood's VAT ID and confirmation in writing.
- We were not able to find a PO on the invoice. Can you confirm the PO number we should reference?

Can you advise who on your side can run a quick reconciliation and provide an adjusted invoice or a credit note? We are trying to close the quarter-end ledger by next Friday.

Thanks,

--
Everleaf Accounts Payable
accounts-payable@everleaf.io

(Attachment: Everleaf_invoice_received.pdf — stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@everleaf.io, Julie Knox <julie.knox@everleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice query — Redwood contract close (Q2 commitments)

Thanks for flagging this, Everleaf and team.

Laura / Karthik — can you take point on the reconciliation? Key asks from Everleaf: validate the unused-burst credit (approx €7.2k per their note), confirm VAT approach and supply Redwood's VAT ID, and add the PO number once provided.

Everleaf — we'll aim to provide either an adjusted invoice or a credit note by Thursday (2027-04-22) EOD CET. Laura, please include a CSV of line-level adjustments so AP can import to their ledger.

Action items:
- Laura: produce provisional credit schedule + adjusted invoice draft.
- Karthik: confirm VAT reverse-charge or taxable treatment and share Redwood VAT ID.
- Priyom: coordinate PO capture and sign-off with customer.

Priyom
Head of Renewals
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: none)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@everleaf.io
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice query — Redwood contract close (Q2 commitments)

Hi all,

Thanks — I ran the numbers against our usage logs and the customer's contract. Notes below and attached drafts: credit_schedule_Q2.csv (line-level offsets) and Everleaf_final_invoice_draft.pdf (provisional adjusted invoice).

Summary of adjustments (EUR):
- Original invoiced amount: 96,400.00
- Confirmed unused burst credit: 7,200.00 (line item credit ID CR-8472-B)
- Net pre-VAT after credit: 89,200.00
- VAT: pending confirmation under reverse-charge. If reverse-charge applies (B2B intra-EU), VAT = 0 on our invoice, but we will include VAT ID fields on the invoice to evidence this.

Requested for AP import: I included a three-column CSV: invoice_line_id, description, adjustment_amount.

Please confirm the PO number so I can finalize the invoice header and re-issue. Also Karthik — please paste Redwood's VAT ID and the short text for the invoice footer confirming reverse-charge treatment if applicable.

Attachments:
- Everleaf_final_invoice_draft.pdf (PDF, draft invoice with credit applied)
- credit_schedule_Q2.csv (CSV, 3 lines)

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager — Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachment stubs: Everleaf_final_invoice_draft.pdf, credit_schedule_Q2.csv)

From: Julie Knox <julie.knox@everleaf.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@everleaf.io, sales_ops@everleaf.io
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice query — Redwood contract close (Q2 commitments)

Thanks Laura — that aligns with our bookkeeping. Two quick updates from Everleaf: 

1) PO number: 9843 — attached signed PO. Please include PO-9843 in the invoice header.
2) VAT: Everleaf is registered in DE (VAT DE998776554). We will apply reverse-charge on our side, but we need Redwood's VAT ID on the invoice as evidence.

We also need a pro-forma credit note for our internal credit memo process (a PDF with the credit line and reference CR-8472-B). Can you issue that alongside the adjusted invoice?

Payment timing: our standard payment run is 30 days from invoice receipt. If we receive the adjusted invoice and credit note by EOD Thu (22 Apr), payment will be scheduled for 22 May 2027. If it slips to next week, payment will move out another cycle.

Attaching: PO-9843-Everleaf.pdf (signed PO).

Best,
Julie
Julie Knox
Finance Manager, Everleaf Therapeutics
julie.knox@everleaf.io

(Attachment: PO-9843-Everleaf.pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Julie Knox <julie.knox@everleaf.io>, accounts-payable@everleaf.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice query — Redwood contract close (Q2 commitments)

Julie / Everleaf AP — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the PO.

Summary and next steps from Redwood: 
- Laura will upload the adjusted invoice and a separate credit note referencing CR-8472-B by 2027-04-22 18:00 CET.
- Karthik confirms Redwood VAT ID: EU-RW-2033147 and will include the reverse-charge footer wording: "VAT not charged. Article 196, Council Directive 2006/112/EC (reverse charge) — intra-EU B2B supply."
- Invoice header will include PO: 9843 and reference DL-8472-EU.
- Finance will send the final PDF to accounts-payable@everleaf.io and CC sales_ops.

If we get confirmation of receipt today we will request finance to mark the settlement flag in our billing system so the payment run aligns with 2027-05-22.

Thanks everyone — Laura / Karthik, ping me when the files are uploaded so I can confirm with Everleaf.

Priyom Das
Head of Renewals
Redwood Inference

(Links: https://hubspot.example/deals/DL-8472-EU; Attachment stubs: Everleaf_final_invoice_draft.pdf, credit_schedule_Q2.csv, PO-9843-Everleaf.pdf)
